purpose: Measure four-odor protected-organism behavior and direct signed PN/DNa02 consumer input over the 250-400-ms odor window, after resolving the 79-ms event-domain failure. This is a diagnostic, not historical stage-3 admission.

biological_rivals.A: Peripheral ORN/ALLN/PN transformation destroys or reverses lateral contrast before PN output.
biological_rivals.B: Contrast survives PN but later circuit convergence/cancellation reverses the descending input.
biological_rivals.C: Descending contrast is usable but baseline command, state history or body readout dominates the absolute yaw.

same_start: Every condition loads the same frozen checkpoint and runs the same zero-odor 40-ms preparation; no reuse of another arm's final state.
measures: Absolute yaw change from odor onset, right-minus-sham and left-minus-sham yaw, bilateral antennal and ORN/PN/DNa02 rates, direct native FP64 signed net before tanh at PN10176/10208 and DNa02 10360/523769, body pose and domain/numeric receipts.
controls: One-ms sham on/off observer equivalence with local sources before long arms; 130-ms sham and 20-ms event/numeric results from earlier campaigns are context, not a certificate to 400 ms. All flow target reconstructions must remain <=1e-9 and finite. Report absolute signs and sham/uniform, not only odor contrasts.
known_confounds: PN10208 left has fine output adapter and PN10176 right uses legacy; no homologation or anatomical surgery in this campaign. DN baseline is not reset at odor onset. Female optogenetic live data cannot be used as a quantitative latency or magnitude reference for this male chemical model. The two motor integrators differed in hidden KC state at 20 ms; no long-horizon fidelity certification exists.
stop: Stop on first observer, domain, source-identity or 2050-s per-run gate failure; preserve completed prefixes. No biological tuning, numeric tolerance change or claim of stage-3 PASS. Do not run remaining odor arms if sham fails.
